ApiToken.description:
An Okta API token, sent as `Authorization: SSWS <token>`.

Created in the Admin Console under Security > API > Tokens. The token
inherits the admin role of the account that created it and is revoked by
Okta after 30 days without use.
ApiToken.title: ApiToken

domain.description: The Okta org domain the Management API is served from, without a scheme. Examples: dev-123456.okta.com, acme.okta-emea.com, acme.oktapreview.com, or a custom domain such as login.acme.com.
domain.title: Okta Domain

start_date.description: UTC date and time in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. Users, groups, and system logs updated before this date will not be captured. If left blank, all available data will be captured.
start_date.title: Start Date
